application_type_full: Outline planning permission: Some matters reserved
description: Following approval for the comprehensive redevelopment of land in Feltham town centre identified by the council as key site M21 (bounded by the railway line, Bedfont Lane, High Street and Highfield Road / Homecourt residential area) to include the demolition of existing residential accommodation, car parks, a public house, library and some retail and office premises and the erection of a mixed use development with extensive public transport improvements, including a new pedestrian footbridge to Feltham Interchange, food superstore, shops (A1), banks and professional and financial services (A2), restaurants (A3), offices (B1), health centre, library and residential (C3) together with improvements to surrounding access routes and the construction of car parks, access roads, enhanced pedestrian links to the surrounding area and landscaping - details submitted pursuant to the reserved matters conditions 1 and 2 design appearance and landscaping of permission approved 5/4/02
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - No commercial floorspace exceeding 27,985 square metres shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 2 - Before development commences details of sightlines at the point of access to the public highway shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall be carried out in accordance with the details.
Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4 m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6 m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
	
Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be constructed. 
Condition : 5 - The roof area of the residential units hereby permitted shall not be used as balconies, roof gardens or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The permission hereby granted does not extend to the approval of details of materials proposed for the east and west elevations of the buildings at Site K and the west and south-west elevations of the buildings at Site H. Prior to commencement of work, details of the materials for those buildings shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 7 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.
Condition : 8 - Before commencement of work, a parking management scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	signing and road marking
(ii)	internal circulation
(iii)	allocation of spaces
(iv)	pricing and method of payment
(v)	pedestrian routes
(vi)	method of operation of barriers
(vii)	hours of operation
(viii)	parking enforcement
The scheme so approved should be fully implemented. 
Condition : 9 - The fitness facility contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as fitness facility ancillary to the main use of the residential units at Site G and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 10 - Before the development is commenced, details of the proposed balconies, railings, canopies, gates and fenestration shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and details so approved shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.
